title: Design an agent branch-first install
summary: Describe the source revision, authorized destination, file set, dry run, and readback an agent needs to install and start a catalog in a fresh session.

origin.source: Provenistem standalone planning and repository audit, 2026-11-20.

benefits: Makes the expected write scope explicit.
risks: A missing ref or permission can send an edit to the wrong place.

evidence.claim: v0.0.2 documents a manual isolated copy and a read-only planner.
